places.as_written: a poor burying ground not very far from here
places.normalized: Paupers' burial ground near Bleak House's London setting (unnamed in passage)
places.quote: she meant a poor burying ground not very far from here, where there was an archway, and a step, and an iron gate.
places.note: Unnamed in the passage; identified only by description and as the burial place of the man who took sleeping-stuff. Location uncertain.
